proofIntro: Press "Get proof number", then write the number on the paper (bill, challan, quotation copy, slip) before photographing it. Each paper gets its own number.
writeOnPaper: Write this number on the paper
fieldHelp: Press "Get proof number" if you do not have one yet.
pageIntro: Files uploaded twice, bills with the same shop or vendor and amount within {{n}} days, and proof numbers used twice. Nothing is blocked; please check and reconcile.
scanned: {{n}} older files were fingerprinted. Press again to continue.
noneOpen: Nothing to check. No possible duplicates are waiting.
noneUnused: Every issued proof number has been used.
unusedIntro: These numbers were issued but no paper has been uploaded with them yet.
